name: User
definition: A registered account on the statistics Q&A site, represented by one row in the users table. Users own posts, write comments, cast votes and earn badges.
scope: Identity, activity and reputation analysis across the codebase_community dataset

name: Post
definition: Any authored entry in the posts table. The table is polymorphic: it holds questions, answers, tag wikis and several auxiliary post kinds distinguished by PostTypeId.
scope: Content and engagement analysis; the parent entity of tags, answers, comments in aggregate and votes

name: Question
definition: A post of type Question (PostTypeId = 1). Questions carry a title, a body, a tag list and the engagement counters ViewCount, AnswerCount, CommentCount and FavoriteCount.
scope: Question-level analysis; the only post kind that carries tags and view/favourite counters

name: Answer
definition: A post of type Answer (PostTypeId = 2) that responds to a question and references its parent question through posts.ParentId.
scope: Answer-level analysis and question answer-count reconciliation

name: Tag
definition: A topical label used to categorise questions, represented in the tags table by a bare lower-case name. Each tag optionally points to a tag wiki page and to a tag wiki excerpt post.
scope: Topic-based filtering and grouping of questions

name: Post Tag Assignment
definition: The association between a question and the tags it carries, physically stored as a delimited token list embedded in the question row rather than as separate rows.
scope: Discovering which tags a given post uses, and which posts carry a given tag

name: Comment
definition: A short remark attached to a post, carrying its own score, body text, creation date and author.
scope: Comment-level text and score analysis, and comment-count reconciliation

name: Vote
definition: A single vote record cast on a post, identified by a vote type. Vote records are distinct from the denormalised lifetime vote counters stored on the user profile.
scope: Vote-row counting and vote-type analysis

name: Badge
definition: An award granted to a user at a point in time, carrying the badge name and the award date.
scope: Achievement, gamification and badge-award analysis

name: Post Link
definition: An explicit relationship recorded between two posts, typed as either a generic link or a duplicate marking.
scope: Cross-post relationship analysis; distinct from the general creation of posts

name: Creation Date
definition: The timestamp at which a record was created, used as the primary time dimension. The physical column name differs per table and is not always spelled the same way.
scope: All temporal filtering, grouping and year extraction

name: Last Access Date
definition: The timestamp at which a user most recently accessed the site, stored on the user account.
scope: User recency and activity-window analysis

name: Calendar Year
definition: The year component extracted from a timestamp, used to bucket events such as account creation, post creation, badge awards and site access.
scope: Annual and seasonal aggregation and year-over-year comparison

name: Display Name
definition: The human-readable label under which a user appears in the site content and by which analytical questions refer to a person. It is an attribute of the account and is not guaranteed to be unique.
scope: Resolving people named in natural-language questions to user accounts

name: View Count
definition: The number of times a question post has been viewed.
scope: Popularity analysis of questions only

name: Post Score
definition: The net score of a post, reflecting the accumulated up and down votes recorded against the post itself.
scope: Post quality and ranking analysis; not interchangeable with comment score

name: Comment Score
definition: The net score of a comment, reflecting votes recorded against that comment.
scope: Comment quality and ranking analysis; not interchangeable with post score

name: Favorite Count
definition: The number of times users have bookmarked a question. This is the measure the workload uses when a question asks for the most valuable post.
scope: Question value and bookmarking analysis

name: Answer Count
definition: The number of answers a question has received, stored as a denormalised counter on the question row and consistent with the answer rows present in the posts table.
scope: Question responsiveness and answer-volume filtering

name: Comment Count
definition: The number of comments a post has received, stored as a denormalised counter on the post row and consistent with the comment rows present in the comments table.
scope: Comment-volume filtering, including identifying posts without comments

name: User Age
definition: The self-declared age of a user, recorded on the account and available only for a minority of users.
scope: Demographic analysis of users where the value is present

name: User Up Vote Counter
definition: A denormalised lifetime counter on the user account recording how many up votes the user has cast. It is a profile attribute, not a count of rows in the votes table.
scope: Per-user voting activity derived from the account record

name: Post Count
definition: The number of post records attributable to a given scope, such as a user or a time window.
scope: Measuring how much a user or a period contributed to the site

name: Vote Count
definition: The number of vote records attributable to a given scope, such as a user or a post.
scope: Measuring voting activity from vote records rather than profile counters

name: Badge Count
definition: The number of badge awards recorded for a given scope, such as a badge name or a period.
scope: Badge award volume analysis

name: Average User Age
definition: The arithmetic mean of the age values present for a set of users. Users without a recorded age do not contribute a value.
scope: Demographic summary over a filtered user set

name: Average View Count
definition: The arithmetic mean of the view counts of a set of question posts.
scope: Comparing popularity across topic groups or time windows

name: Post-to-Vote Ratio
definition: A comparative measure expressing how many posts a user produced relative to the number of votes cast by, or recorded for, that user. Expressed as a quotient of two counts.
scope: Relative contribution analysis comparing two activity counts for the same user

name: Badge Year Share
definition: The proportion of badge awards of a given kind that fall within one calendar year, comparable across years as a percentage.
scope: Year-over-year comparison of badge award distribution
